Department of science & Technology, Govt. of Bihar  
GOVERNMENT ENGGINEERING  COLLEGE, JEHANABAD  
Walipur, Hulasganj, Jehanabad-804407  
Email ID:- Principle@gecjehanabad.ac.in  
Website:- www.gecjehanabad.ac.in 
 
                                                            Assignment-1          
1. Differentiate between procedural programming and object-oriented programming.  
2. Write a program in java to Check whether input character is vowel or consonant.  
3. Write a program in java to display all Prime numbers from 1 to N. 
4. Identify at least three specific OOP features (e.g., Encapsulation, Abstraction, 
Inheritance, Polymorphism) and explain how they would make the system easier to 
maintain or extend. 
5. Differentiate between JDK, JRE, and JVM. 
 
           Assignment – 2 
 
6. Explain static variables, static methods, and static blocks with suitable examples. Why 
are static members associated with the class rather than individual objects? 
7. Write a Java program to show access control using different modifiers. 
8. Explain nested classes and inner classes in Java. Discuss their types with suitable 
examples. 
9. Write a Java program demonstrating the use of the super keyword to:  
a. Access a superclass variable.  
b. Call a superclass method.  
c. Call a superclass constructor. 
10.  Discuss different types of inheritance.
